WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(i.invoice_number) as count
  FROM Invoices i
  INNER JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM gender_counts
),
shares_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    gc.gender,
    gc.count,
    CAST(gc.count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / CAST(tc.total AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as share
  FROM gender_counts gc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares_calc
)
SELECT 
  sc.gender,
  sc.count,
  sc.share,
  sc.share - a.avg_share as difference
FROM shares_calc sc
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE sc.share > a.avg_share
